parsed.note_claim: The footage is from a Nov 2025 anhydrous ammonia leak from a tanker truck at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford OK, with dozens hospitalized and hundreds evacuated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On November 12, 2025, about 9:16 p.m. local time, an Airgas Specialty Products cargo tank transporting Anhydrous Ammonia experienced a leak while parked in Weatherford, Oklahoma. The Airgas driver had stopped at a Holiday Inn Express and Suites
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the date, location, tanker truck, and Holiday Inn Express details, and states 74 individuals were injured and 500-1,000 evacuated, matching the note's claims.
